slices.title: Request inspector
slices.summary: Adds GetRequestSnapshot RPC and PromptSection message to run_ledger.proto (no new migration), applies the D3 filter server-side in session-core (platform sections lose text), and the owner-only route GET /v1/runs/:run_id/requests/:call_seq refusing ZDR bearers (404 when MODEL_GATEWAY_REQUEST_INSPECTOR off). FE adds RequestInspector tab with copy JSON and an incomplete-record notice, plus action contract chat.inspect_run_request. Per round A C6, the section label table must include EP-8 locale/tone/user_profile sections (user_profile = user text, tone/locale = platform text) and EP-6 agent role instructions (org text). Adds golden case e_zdr_bearer_run_inspection_refused for the S7 route.
slices.remaining: D3: which prompt text the run owner sees (recommendation: platform sections as label + version digest + length, org and user sections as text; owner-only). PROD and OWN decide. Also needs S6 built.

slices.title: Org domain rules on fetch and search, Quarry re-check
slices.summary: Grants model-gateway and execution-core the org:browser-site:read:any scope, adds a pure host canonicaliser and fetch_allowed in mp-contracts, and per-service resolve clients with a 30 s cache (unreadable = deny). fetch_url/web_fetch is checked before the call (typed org_site_blocked), and search sends the org block list as exclude_domains (max 64) and drops hits on denied hosts. Proto: execution.proto WebPolicyContext.site_policy_revision = 4 (inside the W2 message). No migration. Switch WEB_DOMAIN_POLICY_MODE off|shadow|enforce, default off, unknown = enforce.
slices.remaining: C-B1 (single org web-policy store: w23 organization_web_policy vs DEC-19 browsersites) and D-W1/D-W2 (rules sent per call as a request layer). Quarry half (/v1/extract deny list, policy_rev echo) belongs to the Quarry plan; Model half can build once ruled.

slices.title: Elicitation in the governed loop: resume question, pause, answer the held call
slices.summary: mcp_gateway.rs sets ProxyMcpToolRequest.allow_elicitation from GovernedMcp and gains an McpElicitationService client and answer_elicitation. execute_mcp (runtime_loop/mod.rs:2315): on a pending form create a question (delivery resume, origin mcp_elicitation, origin_label server label, items from the form, expires = hold left, idempotency {run}:{step}:elicit:<n>) and return the WS14-S5 input-pause outcome. resume.rs: consume the answer, map it back, AnswerMcpElicitation accept; skip -> decline; expiry/cancel -> cancel; lost held call -> tool error mcp_elicitation_expired. agent.rs admission: allow only when MCP_DO_ELICITATION (literal true, default off) && depth 0 && not ZDR/waived && parkable && no space_id; counts against MAX_QUESTIONS_PER_RUN.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib elicitation
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib mcp_gateway

decisions_defaults.D7: Elicitation is a WS14 resume question; the run pauses; the held call is answered on resume
decisions_defaults.D8: Flat schema mapped to QuestionItem (string->text, enum->single, boolean->single, number->text validated), <=4 fields; nested/arrays/sensitive names declined
decisions_defaults.D9: Run owner only; depth-0, non-ZDR, non-waived, parkable, non-Space runs only
decisions_defaults.D16: An answer that reaches a replica without the held call fails closed as mcp_elicitation_expired
